top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff files show that 2 did not have dates of employment.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the five enrolled children's admission information was not available upon request.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))
Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cot was observed to be blocking the exit door in a classroom. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the cot from in front of the door.
